messages:
rachel_sales: Heads up - HeliosInc returned redlines on MSA/DPA and says procurement will only issue a PO before countersigning the Order Form. Their asks: Net45, PO must reference OF#, expanded auditor access, and an HSM/KMS clause. POC blocked pending PO.

mina_ops: Can ops provision on PO-only? we need explicit guardrails if MSA unsigned.

vic_finance: Finance can accept PO as commitment if PO includes billing entity + tax id and explicit OF reference. Otherwise require a capped trial credit or 1 month prepay. Net45 only after entity validation.

carl_legal: I reviewed the redlines. They want broad auditor access - not acceptable. Proposed workaround: a "Limited Provisioning Addendum" (30d) that limits auditor scope to read-only log extracts via portal, caps liability for the POC, and expires if MSA not signed in 30 days. I'll draft a focused addendum and an ops Exhibit A.

anya_sec: Security: we have SOC2 Type II summary. No public HSM attestation today. For POC we can offer KMS placeholder and enforce short retention (14d), disable exports, and restrict access. HSM available via Private deployment (~2-3 weeks) if they need it.

mina_ops: If we accept addendum, ops will: enforce 14d retention, disable exports, restrict roles to named contacts, and only spin up a dedicated sandbox. ETA 4 business days after PO + billing info + signed ack.

rachel_sales: Customer said PO will be sent today and will reference OF-2026-921. They're open to the Limited Provisioning Addendum. I'll push for the exact billing contact and PO PDF.

carl_legal: Drafted addendum uploaded. Key points: provisional access, limited audit scope, expiration at 30 days, trial liability cap. If customer pushes broader language we escalate.

vic_finance: Once PO PDF arrives, please cc billing@redwood.com with billing contact and tax/VAT. We'll validate entity and set up invoice flow.

rachel_sales: Action items: Carl -> finalize addendum and exhibit; Vic -> prep billing template; Anya -> attach SOC2 summary + HSM note; Mina -> reserve infra slot; Rachel -> collect PO PDF and billing contact. Will update when PO lands. :thumbsup:
